title: Show live optimizer activity through an inspectable app panel
description: During labeling show a compact status of trigger checks, queued/running optimization, ML fit, completion or error without covering article/vote controls. Open a right drawer/panel for live activity; drill into exact optimizer request with full trusted-label explanations, response/tool calls, decision request/response with actual example text and labels, before/after rubric/questions/examples/head, candidate evaluation and promotion/rejection reason. Use provider-neutral names, not Luna-specific UI. API cursor subscriptions update without reload; reconnect deduplicates events and recovers current job state. Feedback-save acknowledgement is separate from optimization completion; do not leave UI disabled or silently retry paid calls. Acceptance: fake GraphQL/UI cycle shows each phase and precise exchanges; mobile status/drawer remains readable; submitting labels responds immediately and eventual errors are actionable.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Live activity now has a right drawer independent of labeling layout; retains exact event inspector and expands recent activity to triggers, stage starts/failures, labels and metrics. No fullscreen toggle remains. Remaining: structured per-stage status, paired exchanges and full context inspector acceptance, reconnect/recovery fixture verification.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Live activity inspector now pairs requests/responses using durable classifier, step and briefing identities. Selecting an optimizer response shows its full prompt/context and tool calls, not another classifiers nearby request. Decision inspection filters target+cycle+step. Exact cached decision requests displayed separately; missing correlation explicitly unavailable. Three regression tests added. Remaining: real browser acceptance on recorded multi-round events and richer before/after summaries.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Browser acceptance against the real recorded three-classifier session: selecting latest optimizer response (cycle 81) rendered its paired full system/user request plus response/tool calls. User context contains 47 feedback items and one human_explanations entry. Added activity-type filter to reach optimizer exchanges despite newer decision traffic and drill-down replaces the list with Back to activity rather than burying details below 40 rows. No model calls or human labels during verification. Evidence screenshot var/web/paired-optimizer-exchange.png. Remaining: before/after structured summaries and broader tablet acceptance.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Added a compact event-derived Flywheel activity summary in labeling, separate from feedback-save acknowledgement. It names classifier/stage and distinguishes request sent, response awaiting validation, fitting, selection, accepted/no change, partial failure, waiting, budget pause and command failure. Native trigger-evaluated/step lifecycle events now appear in the activity drawer; no-op checks do not erase the last optimization outcome. Inspecting completed rubric/examples/questions steps now correlates exact optimizer requests and responses using durable scope, not temporal proximity. Specs observed failing first; 125 UI tests and build pass. Browser verified real recorded 85-cycle run shows Anthus ML optimization Accepted with its actual reason, opens exact completion event and retains the optimizer exchange filter; no console errors, new votes or paid calls. Screenshot var/web/live-activity-status-proof.jpg. React skill kept status purely derived; verification used existing API-owned history. Structured before/after configuration and broader tablet/reconnect acceptance remain open.
